strongest_argument: The exact figure the claim is built on - RMB880.0m of cash, restricted cash, term deposits and short-term investments at 2026-03-31 versus RMB936.4m at 2025-12-31 - is a verbatim line item in So-Young's own PR Newswire release of 2026-05-22, syndicated the same day to TradingView, Benzinga, TipRanks, Nasdaq and Investing.com. It has been public for one hundred days. Worse for the claim, the deceleration it purports to discover was already published two months earlier: the 2026-03-25 Q4/FY2025 release put the balance at RMB936.4m against RMB942.8m at 2025-09-30, i.e. Q4 2025 cash use of RMB6.4m. Against that series the Q1 2026 figure is not a collapse to a low run-rate, it is a quarter-on-quarter ACCELERATION of burn from 6.4m to 56.4m. The stale RMB300m-plus per quarter figure being refuted is a self-media arithmetic error: Huxiu took the RMB310m nine-month decline from 1,253.2m to 942.8m and captioned it as a single quarter. No wire, no sell-side note and no company document ever carried a 300m quarterly run-rate, so there is no priced belief for this finding to correct. And the market did react to this disclosure: SY traded down about 9.4% premarket on 2026-05-22 with the cash line in front of it. A fact that was published, that moved the price the wrong way, and whose direction the claim has inverted, is priced.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Company release states the claim's exact figures: RMB880.0m at 2026-03-31 versus RMB936.4m at 2025-12-31.

Q4/FY2025 release gives RMB936.4m at 2025-12-31 which against RMB942.8m at 2025-09-30 implies Q4 2025 cash use of only RMB6.4m - the burn deceleration was public five months before this print, and makes Q1 2026 a worsening quarter.
The Chinese piece cited as the stale counter-narrative in fact implies roughly RMB108m per quarter, not RMB300m.
Source of the RMB300m-plus single-quarter figure, which is the nine-month RMB310m decline mislabelled as one quarter - an arithmetic error, not a market belief.

baseline_evidence: The relevant reaction window is 2026-05-22, not the trailing twenty days: the stock fell ~9.4% premarket on the day the RMB880.0m line was published, so the market saw the low burn and did not read it as de-risking. The +30.4% 20d run-up spans roughly 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-28 and cannot be attributed to a May disclosure; the identifiable August catalyst is the 2026-08-03 CFO appointment, and on 171,890 ADS average daily volume the move is largely noise. Spot sits -46.3% from the 52w high. Options carry no signal either way: 200 total contracts, put/call OI 0.11, 25d skew null.
materiality: immaterial as an increment - the cash level is material (US$127.6m against a $240.9m market cap) but the incremental fact is the difference between RMB56.4m and a mis-derived RMB300m, both measured off balances the company published itself; the Q4 2025 comparator of RMB6.4m makes Q1 2026 a worsening quarter, so the claim's sign is wrong against the company's own numbers
what_would_change_my_verdict: Evidence that the 2026-06-30 cash balance itself, not the already-published 2026-03-31 figure, is knowable and materially better than the Q1 trajectory implies; or a US-distributed wire or sell-side note dated before 2026-08-30 that actually carried a RMB300m-plus quarterly burn assumption and was therefore the priced belief.
